Jeu de tir à l'arc : maintiens le clic e: An archery game: hold the mouse button and drag back to aim and set the power, then release. Ten arrows per round, 10 points in the centre of the target and 1 on the edge; the windsock shows a wind that changes with every shot, and the target moves back every three arrows before it starts moving.
La manche à air montre le vent : il pous: The windsock shows the wind: it pushes the arrow throughout its flight.
Le début de la trajectoire est montré en: The start of the trajectory is shown in dotted lines, without the wind. The target moves back every 3 arrows, then begins to move.
